title: Georgia Tech couple clears up viral televised argument during football game
summary_full: Tallulah Wall and Braden Flournoy says their discussion that riveted viewers ‘was completely insignificant’A couple whose heated discussion in the stands of a recent college football game in Atlanta was nationally and virally televised has spoken out about the experience – saying it ended up being how most of the people in their lives learned they were dating.Georgia Tech students Tallulah Wall and Braden Flournoy appeared on NBC’s Today show on Tuesday, three days after ESPN showed them having an intense conversation while watching their school’s football team lose resoundingly in their home stadium to Wake Forest.
